\section*{Highlights}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.4em,itemsep=2pt]
\item Streaming quasi-Newton intervals converge to a wrong coverage on dependent data.
\item That limiting coverage is derived exactly from one variance-inflation factor.
\item Blocking the gradient step makes the long-run variance estimable for free.
\item The valid interval is cheaper: per block, not per observation.
\item Blocking creates a step-size condition; an O(d) safeguard restores it.
\end{itemize}
